title: Cobblemon: Mythical Exploration
description: Adds Mythical Pokémon structures to Cobblemon and makes them obtainable. No extra dependencies required.
body:
___
Generates semi-rare structures that allow you to obtain Mythical Pokémon without any other dependencies. Originally made for private use but I decided to make it an addon. This datapack was made with zero knowledge and 40 Youtube tutorials, so bear with me if it's a bit messy.
Does __not__ provide models.

Support and Suggestions Thread: https://discord.com/channels/934267676354834442/1518412812207259778

Each generated Pokémon has Max IVs, have fun.


### Each structure has a **1/100** chance to generate as a **shiny** Structure, which alters the design of the structure slightly.
___

## _All Mythicals currently obtainable:_

### **[ - ] Seabreak Island - Shaymin**

Seabreak Island generates on Lukewarm and Deep Lukewarm Oceans. The island is filled with flowers, alongside a Level 30 Shaymin.

### **[ - ] Chamber of the Jewel - Diancie**

Diancie's chamber generates below the ground in all biomes, in Y=30. The chasm is filled with valuable ores, alongside a Level 30 Diancie.

### **[ - ] Birth Island - Deoxys**

Birth Island generates on Cold and Deep Cold Oceans. Alongside a Level 50 Deoxys.

### **[ - ] Isle of Dreams - Jirachi**

Isle of Dreams generates over Forests, Flower Forests, Windswept Forests, Sparse Jungles, Plains and Sunflower Plains at Y=215, Features overwhelming vegetation, alongside a Level 30 Jirachi.

### **[ - ] Garden of Origin - Meloetta**

Garden of Origin generates on Meadows. Features a small lake and flowers, alongside a Level 40 Meloetta.

### **[ - ] Abandoned Research Station - Magearna**

Abandoned Research Station generates on Snowy Plains. Features a snow covered research station, alongside a Level 20 Magearna.

### **[ - ] Ruins of Aredia - Victini**

Ruins of Aredia generates on Deserts. It is a massive hard-to-miss structure featuring gold ores and other goods, alongside a Level 50 Victini.
___
